description.value: Sky Blue Waters Motel is a lakeside resort on Shuswap Lake in Tappen, BC, offering 8 fully equipped motel units with kitchens, living areas, and air conditioning. Situated halfway between Calgary and Vancouver — just 16 km west of Salmon Arm and 1.8 km off the Trans-Canada Highway — it makes a convenient overnight stop on a cross-province tour. The broader resort also includes a campground with full and partial hookups, giving cyclists with tents or trailers an alternative to motel rooms.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright 2026) and confirms this is a real, operating lakeside motel resort on Shuswap Lake. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, laundry, e-bike charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Two different phone numbers appear on the site: 250.835.4531 on the motel page and 250.515.1811 on the contact, map, and camping pages; the contact page is treated as authoritative. OSM tags internet_access=wlan is not confirmed by website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per rules.
concerns: Two different phone numbers appear on the website: 250.835.4531 on the motel page vs. 250.515.1811 on the contact, map, and camping pages. The contact page number (250.515.1811) was used as the primary phone. OSM has no phone listed.
OSM lists no phone number; phone was sourced entirely from the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating lakeside motel with an active website; a logical overnight stop for cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor between Salmon Arm and Kamloops.
